tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Find published articles by topic keywords, publisher or publication name. Case and spacing/punctuation in names are normalized. Meaningful query words must match metadata together or an individual passage; this is lexical retrieval, not semantic answer generation. Use publication/publisher filters (

tools.name: get_article_preview
